Method of Attack: Creates a botnet by targeting WatchGuard Firebox and other SOHO network devices
Uses infected devices' legitimate firmware update channels to maintain access by injecting malicious code and deploying repacked firmware images
Persists on reboot and throughout the legitimate firmware update process
Modules developed to upload/download files to/from command-and-control server, collect and exfiltrate device information, and update the malware
Attack Vector: Firmware update process of network devices
